SEE ALL SERVICES > Detox Sauna Organic Facials Body Treatments Frequently Asked Questions Do you offer shipping? Absolutely! We currently offer in store shopping and domestic shipping across all USA states and territories including Puerto Rico. We are also able to ship to many international countries. Are your herbs organic? Our herbs are a mix of organic and wild crafted products. We do NOT currently certify organic as we are a smaller retailer and the costs are astronomical to do so. We source from vendors who employ ethical farming and do not employ pesticides in their farming. Where do you source your herbs and teas? Our bulk herbs and teas come from different vendors and farmers in different regions of the world. We do not have a single source. Our sourcing strategy is to purchase herbs and ingredients from where they are native to or where they are sustainably and organically grown. Do you make your products? We have both in house made and curated products to make sure we are bringing you the best possible products. Majority of our body care are handmade in house. We currently work with a vendor to source our supplements, tinctures and powder blends. Do you have other locations? We currently have one retail showroom and self care space in the city of Farmers Branch, Dallas, Texas A Passion For Healing - Meet the Herbalist Esthetician It all began with my quest to find a natural solution for cystic acne, gut and hormonal issues. Growing up in West Africa, I was immersed in a culture that turned to nature for healing and beautification. My vision was to make it easy to discover authentic traditional products and services from around the world that nourish the body inside and out. I welcome you to be a part of our community by joining our Total Body Club. Here you will get exclusive perks, exclusive member pricing and other benefits that will support you in supercharging your wellness. I look forward to having you as part of our wellness circle.
